episodes.title: No Country Is Safe
episodes.summary: Their family now in danger, Tony and Ziva must find who is behind a nefarious cyber-attack.

episodes.title: No Friend of Mine
episodes.summary: Tony and Ziva track down the elusive hacker, only to join forces when Interpol closes in.

episodes.title: Cover Story
episodes.summary: Unsure who to trust and framed for a terrorist bombing, Tony and Ziva go off the grid.

episodes.title: Wedding Crashers
episodes.summary: Tony and Ziva use a wedding as an undercover operation to root out their enemies.

episodes.title: To Be Determined
episodes.summary: The missing secretary general of Interpol leads Tony and Ziva to a high security prison.

episodes.title: We've Got Company
episodes.summary: The stakes grow even higher when the safe house Tali has been hiding in is compromised.

episodes.title: Dark Mirror
episodes.summary: Tony and Ziva return to Paris on a mission to spy on the double agents who are framing them.

episodes.title: Fire Sale
episodes.summary: Connecting the dots to a high-tech weapons manufacturer put Tony and Ziva in the crosshairs.

episodes.title: Ride or Die
episodes.summary: With the enemy in sight and everything on the line, Tony and Ziva must face all their fears.

episodes.title: Full Circle
episodes.summary: To stop a deadly international attack, Tony and Ziva risk it all and learn who they can trust.
